---
description: "Phase- and outcome-specific RPIR assurance checklist"
---

# Stage assurance checklist

Apply only checks relevant to the supplied draft and intended effect. Return cited advice, not approval or a phase-wide veto.

## Evidence and identity

- [ ] Subject, phase, actual inspected version and original channel/locator are clear. Facts, assumptions, real questions and unavailable evidence are not conflated.
- [ ] Future reports/chat follow the [shared reader-facing rule](../rpir-lifecycle-core/SKILL.md#reader-facing-outputs): phase-owned result, inspected predecessor links instead of repeated analysis, no running discovery/change diary or compulsory empty categories. Required actions remain; actual qualified/nonrecommended selections/conditions, failed/unavailable/not-run required checks, partial delivery, consequential corrections/rechecks, unsaved tracking, every expected checkpoint disposition and per-record ADR invocation/verified recording remain visible. Inspect material linked sections/versions; a missing source needs an affected-effect route, not assumed evidence or a blanket stop.
- [ ] Real numbered physical records are contained in the verified Research folder and have inspected kind/content and direct same-folder predecessor links. Never infer a local identity from a remote label or invent lineage; legacy folders remain usable.
- [ ] A claimed new record has non-overwriting allocation, applicable permission, actual save and readback evidence. On collision re-inspect and choose an absent number in the same verified topic when safe; a failed save remains unfinished. Do not demand double inventories, mandatory fingerprints, routine command probes or status mirrors.
- [ ] If a lifecycle record is checkpointed, confirm its physical save/readback preceded the optional Git metadata effect; marker persistence and required validation remain independent. Do not require a marker-only commit or rewrite finalized reports to add a commit ID; a report's own future commit ID belongs in later evidence/chat.

## Conversation evidence rubric

Assess only dimensions supported by available evidence; cite actual messages when available and mark unavailable dimensions **unverified**. A brief's account is a recorded claim, not an observed conversation. Do not infer message order, tool chronology, resource loading or runtime behavior from authored rules or a report. Hypothetical examples test the authored illustration only.

The [eight handoff reliability scenario pairs](./handoff-reliability-scenarios.md) give reproducible examples and assessor reasoning for this distinction; use them proportionately, not as a new universal gate or runtime experiment.

| Dimension | Evidence to assess |
| --- | --- |
| Framing | Simple clarification may be direct without mandatory labels or letters; material choices receive useful context, supported advice and alternatives where needed. Optional structure is not an approval substitute; ordinary updates need no question format. |
| Paths and advice | Where choices help, they meaningfully resolve uncertainty; advice is supported, and unknown factual conclusions route to evidence rather than guessed facts. Free text, qualification and useful other/unknown answers remain possible. |
| Answer dependency and faithfulness | Consequential answers inform current understanding and the next useful question; actual qualified or nonrecommended direction and conditions are honored, not replaced by the recommendation. No running answer-change history is required. |
| Thought development | Relevant dimensions are answered/supported, reasonedly inapplicable, or unresolved with consequence and next step; supplied information is not re-asked, and headings/count alone do not prove understanding. |
| Waiting and lookup order | Where chronological messages/tool events are available, verify actual waiting, acknowledgment/deferral, stated lookup purpose/bound and return-to-dialogue order. If unavailable, mark unverified. |
| Downstream readiness | Assess whether cited proportionate investigation establishes a viable mechanism and decision-critical feasibility, realistic alternatives/trade-offs and a recommendation distinct from actual qualified/nonrecommended direction. An unestablished essential mechanism, architectural or not, is unfinished Research with affected effects and an evidence route, not a ready delivery task. A material residual names the supported mechanism tested, what was investigated, why it reasonably remains, downstream consequence and bounded resolution route; execution-dependent, newly exposed or permission-limited facts may qualify, but a route alone does not justify accessible essential research left undone. Plan checks freshness/applicability, reuses selections and converts supported conclusions; inherited essential gaps or genuinely new requirements/evidence reopening feasibility need a scoped engineer-directed Research continuation or supplementation where evidence is needed, not hidden research or retroactive blame. Truthful drafts, independent supported work and manual invocation remain; no investigation quota, zero-unknowns rule, inspection ban, automatic restart or readiness veto. Do not infer Plan-owned scope, hierarchy or acceptance. |
| Correction and closure | Supported in-boundary issues receive diagnosis, authorized correction and actual recheck, not report-only deferral or optional-advice evasion. Research/Plan correct only eligible working artifacts; Implement repairs approved-outcome defects. Review remains source-read-only and routes original-criteria defects through manual Implement resumption under the original approved Plan, fresh evidence and independent re-review; unresolved findings prevent acceptance. Genuine material changes receive an evidence-backed recommended engineer-owned/Plan resolution, not silent expansion. |

## Delivery and material boundaries

- [ ] Each hold distinguishes decision, evidence, ADR content/agreement/persistence, capability and permission limits; cites the affected effect, supporting evidence, next permitted route and independently authorized work with its authority, or explains why none exists. Independent investigation is not source-edit authority; an unavailable route or recorded refusal is not an observed platform denial. Do not infer runtime effectiveness from static passes, chronology from recorded claims or permission from readiness advice. Assess supported correction/recheck and actual results rather than mere issue logging; no denial bypass or new approval gate.
- [ ] Every prospective Plan has one explicit bounded checkpoint strategy; every detailed Work Item references it and states its normal post-validation boundary and coherent content/purpose, or a specific justified combination/deferral/no-commit exception. Each exception states actual constraint/reason, affected IDs, validation/dependency consequence, later boundary if one exists and why normal is unsuitable. Missing entries, empty headings, generic exemptions and unexplained blanket bans fail planning assessment, but actual prohibitions, including historical Plans, still grant no Git authority. No fabricated future obstacle or historical rewrite.
- [ ] Implement/Review compare planned versus actual accounting at every expected boundary before unrelated work, including earlier coherent validated Task consideration and actual disposition evidence. Identify omissions and unjustified departures; runtime obstacles belong in fresh implementation evidence, not retrospective substantive approved-Plan exceptions. Retain distinct skips—not applicable/no eligible changes, not attempted, unavailable/unresolved, failed, no commit verified, verified, unexpected and uncertain outcomes and reconciliation needs under the [shared capability](../local-git-checkpoints/SKILL.md). Distinguish observed timely handling, observed late/omitted handling and unverified chronology; silence or final history/markers prove neither timing nor compliance. Commit count is not technical acceptance and a supported no-commit outcome is not defective delivery. These checks remain advisory, not approval or Git authority.
- [ ] A Plan describes approved outcome, original acceptance and material constraints rather than prescribing every branch, test or related file. Material unknowns are named and routed promptly to the engineer, without stopping unrelated safe work.
- [ ] Assess complete architectural choice coverage against Research, the approved Plan and actual changes, including missing or partial coverage even when a valid ADR is bound. Inspect each choice's rationale, alternatives, selection/pending state, conditions and affected Work Items in reused/grouped records; a vague umbrella record is insufficient. Proportionality governs detail, not coverage, even for small reversible spikes. For unexpected uncovered or changed architecture, advise engineer-directed Plan resolution before dependent architectural effects; continue independent approved work. Routine naming, helper extraction and architecture-preserving repairs remain Implement-owned without ADR reference; resolve material classification ambiguity with the engineer using evidence through the coordinator. No ADR authorship is granted.
- [ ] If the Plan binds an ADR, check traceability of its inspected identity/version/state/conditions and dependent Work Items. Keep architectural agreement, Plan approval, delivery invocation and Review acceptance distinct; assurance is advisory, not approval or a phase-wide veto.
- [ ] For exact-snapshot sign-off, compare the report's actual invocation and each per-record save/readback outcome with the inspected ADR preimage/postimage, authority/conditions and effective-policy timing. Invocation alone is not persisted `Accepted`; no invocation predating effective policy is retroactive. Review remains source-read-only and a clean delivery Review is not ADR sign-off. Assurance is advisory and grants no ADR status-write authority.
- [ ] Implement compares the actual principal artifact/diff with the Plan and preserves user changes. Ordinary failures can be diagnosed, repaired and rechecked productively; failed acceptance is not described as passed and a partial report is not delivery.
- [ ] Actual platform denial is respected, not bypassed. Uncertain destructive/external completion is reconciled before repetition; local failed checks are not assumed to be external deployments. Execution evidence is distinguished from validation.
- [ ] Review independently checks original criteria and classifies findings by severity, actionable/unclear status, and original-criteria correction/material change. Supported correction may manually resume Implement under the original approved Plan with linked Review context, fresh evidence and independent re-review. Material changes require an engineer decision and Plan-owned amendment/new Plan. Unresolved findings prohibit acceptance.

## Stage-specific outcome

- **Research:** Check current understanding, sourced answer, assumptions, provenance and material downstream decisions/limits against the [brief schema](../codebase-research/research-brief-template.md) and [discovery method](../agent-question-resolution/references/research-intent-discovery.md). Assess the supported technical conclusion or identify unfinished essential feasibility and its affected-effect/evidence route. Retain actual qualified/nonrecommended choices and conditions and meaningful alternative-framing outcome, not a running discovery or answer-change history. The method still requires the labelled hypothesis, brief probe and engineer direction choice before deeper exploration. Assess actual acknowledgment/correction of a substantive readback, pending acknowledgment, or explicit engineer-directed deferral with provisional understanding, scope/timing and dependent limits; detailed/factual/solution-led requests do not bypass discovery. Distinguish recorded claims from observed messages, chronological lookup/tool ordering and resource loading; a brief alone does not prove waiting or loading. Where evidence exists, verify acknowledgment or deferral before broad/delegated work or substantive solution advice. Unobserved behavior/loading remains unverified; no transcript, new capture or report kind is required. Do not treat acknowledgment/assurance as transition approval, require confirmation after honored deferral, or request routine folder-name approval. A truthfully provisional brief is valid; remaining questions do not suppress eligible persistence or authorize broad pre-acknowledgment work. A saved brief does not invoke Plan.
- **Every phase:** Apply the conversation evidence rubric to actual engineer-facing questions using the shared Skill/template; do not import Research's initial interview into Plan, Implement or Review.
- **Plan:** Check Research (or material Review-origin) ancestry, outcome, acceptance, risks and any genuine unresolved decisions. Assess freshness and delivery conversion of the supported mechanism; route inherited essential gaps or newly reopened feasibility through scoped engineer-directed Research continuation/supplementation where evidence is needed, while independent planning and truthful drafts continue. Check each material residual's supported mechanism, reason it remains and bounded evidence/response, affected effects, escalation and independent work. Reconcile every Research architectural choice and planning discovery to inspected ADR path/ID, identifiable section, substantive version/state, actual agreement/conditions and affected Work Items, or a truthful gap with dependent effects and resolution route. A valid ADR for some choices does not cover omissions; verify substantive applicability of existing/grouped coverage without demanding duplicates. If none are architectural, require an evidence-supported routine-only disposition. A saved Plan alone does not invoke Implement.
- **Implement:** Check actual output, completed versus remaining work and **Performed**, **Failed**, **Unavailable**, **Not run** evidence. An absent or invalid essential mechanism needs engineer/Plan resolution and scoped Research when evidence is needed; ordinary inspection, local decisions, related-file selection, failure diagnosis, repair and recheck remain allowed under actual scope and permission, without an automatic Research restart. Compare existing Step/Task/Work Item markers with supported outcomes and explicit exit-gate evidence; check that parent-only failures retain children, contrary evidence reopens only invalidated/dependent markers with reasons, and persistence limitations are disclosed. Where chronology is available, assess completion-to-save/readback before unrelated later work; distinguish observed timely action, observed late/omitted backfill and unverified timing, never inferring timing from final markers. Assess the inspected Plan strategy/approval reference and expected checkpoint opportunities, including no-commit paths and evidence-based cadence exceptions; no silence-based pass or commit-count gate. Keep checkpoint evidence separate from technical validation. This is evidence alignment, not a new approval gate. `/review` with a verified physical report admits review, not acceptance.
- **Review:** Check the full intended implementation range and relevant remaining work, not merely the latest commit/report; verify the baseline/range where possible and carry unavailable facts without guessing. Check physical report, Plan, changed work and independent findings. Only verified clean Review records acceptance; optional status bookkeeping is not a second gate.

Assurance cannot edit, execute, allocate, persist, grant scope/permission or veto an engineer-approved transition. Identify only dependent unsafe effects and smallest supported next actions; handoffs remain manual.
